Hey Maya —

Great to meet you and Raj on yesterday's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the end of quarter: 

- What we learned: StellarApps is prioritizing a faster inference path for your customer-facing summarization pipeline; target latency < 350ms p95 and cost reduction of ~30% vs current provider.
- Proposed start: Redwood Dedicated trial (4 GPU reserved) + integration support for the month of Aug to validate perf on real traffic.
- Deliverables from us: tailored proposal (attached), example config for batching/kv-cache, SOW draft for integration work.
- Mutual action items:
  - Maya/Raj: confirm procurement/approval timeline and whether budget is committed for this quarter or needs to shift to next.
  - Aditya/Redwood: send revised commercial with a short pilot option (attached).

Proposed next call: 30 minutes next week (Tue/Wed) to review proposal and procurement steps. If EOQ is a hard deadline for your team, please flag and we can prioritize a faster onboarding path.

Attaching: redwood-proposal-stellarapps-v2.pdf, sow-draft-stellarapps.docx

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.
